definition_zh: 巧克力；巧克力糖；深褐色
definition_en: a sweet brown food made from cocoa beans, a small sweet piece of it, or the dark brown colour of it
core_image: 掰开一块排块巧克力时露出的整齐方格
scene: 桌上摊着没写完的作业，孩子偷偷伸出手。She hid a bar of chocolate under her pillow.
sceneCN: 这里 chocolate 指「巧克力」（第 1 个义项：用可可豆制成的甜食）；句意是她把一块巧克力藏在了枕头下面。

derivatives.zh: 巧克力制作师；巧克力商

senses.title: A sweet food from cocoa
senses.definition: a sweet brown food made from roasted and ground cocoa beans
senses.definitionCN: 用烘焙研磨的可可豆制成的褐色甜食
senses.example: She melted the chocolate in a small pan.
senses.exampleCN: 她用小锅把巧克力化开。
senses.why: The Aztecs drank a bitter cocoa mixture, and sugar turned that drink into the solid food we know.
senses.whyCN: 阿兹特克人喝苦涩的可可饮料，加糖后那种饮料变成了今天这种固体甜食。

senses.title: A single sweet piece
senses.definition: a small sweet made of chocolate, often with a soft filling
senses.definitionCN: 用巧克力做成的小糖果，常带柔软夹心
senses.example: He offered me a chocolate from the box.
senses.exampleCN: 他从盒子里拿了一颗巧克力给我。
senses.why: Once the food was sold in small moulded pieces, the countable piece took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 这种甜食开始做成小块出售之后，可数的一块也叫同一个名字。

senses.title: A dark brown colour
senses.definition: a deep brown colour like that of plain chocolate
senses.definitionCN: 像纯巧克力那样的深褐色
senses.example: The walls were painted a warm chocolate.
senses.exampleCN: 墙被刷成了温暖的深褐色。
senses.why: The colour of the food became a colour name by direct comparison.
senses.whyCN: 食物的颜色通过直接类比变成了颜色名称。

intro.en: Chocolate comes from a Nahuatl word for a bitter cocoa drink.
intro.cn: chocolate 源出纳瓦特尔语，本指一种苦涩的可可饮料。

items.en: Xocolatl named a bitter drink made from cocoa.
items.cn: xocolatl 指用可可制成的一种苦味饮料。

items.en: Spanish explorers carried the drink home as chocolate.
items.cn: 西班牙探险者以 chocolate 之名把这种饮料带回本国。

items.en: English borrowed the Spanish word and kept its spelling.
items.cn: 英语借入这个西班牙语词，并保留了拼写。

items.en: Sugar and milk turned the drink into a solid sweet food.
items.cn: 糖与牛奶把这种饮料变成了固体甜食。

items.en: The word then named small sweets and the dark brown colour.
items.cn: 这个词随后又指小块糖果与深褐色。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps cocoa words with a similar shape, while the meaning group names sweet foods.
note.cn: 形近组列出拼写相近的可可类词，近义组列出各种甜食。

entries.definition: the brown powder left after cocoa beans are pressed
entries.definitionCN: 可可豆压榨后留下的褐色粉末

entries.definition: the coconut palm or its large nut
having the taste or smell of chocolate
entries.definitionCN: 带有巧克力味道或气味的

entries.definition: a sweet food made mainly with sugar
a small piece of sweet food eaten as a treat
entries.definitionCN: 当作小享受来吃的一小块甜食

entries.definition: a sweet food made with sugar and flavourings
entries.definitionCN: 用糖和调味料制成的甜食

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the cocoa source, the bar and piece contrast, the drink and the colour.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用可可来源、排块与单颗的对比、饮料义以及颜色义。

normal.en: Chocolate keeps its Spanish shape, so the first syllable does not sound like church.
normal.cn: chocolate 保留了西班牙语的外形，所以开头并不读成 church 的音。

normal.en: Cocoa is the powder and chocolate is the food: two words grow from one bean.
normal.cn: cocoa 是粉，chocolate 是食物：一个豆子长出两个词。

normal.en: A bar is one whole block, while a chocolate is one small piece in a box.
normal.cn: a bar 是整块，a chocolate 是盒子里的一小颗。

normal.en: Hot chocolate is a drink and chocolate brown is a colour, both from the same noun.
normal.cn: hot chocolate 是饮料，chocolate brown 是颜色，都来自同一个名词。

normal.en: Chocolatier adds the agent suffix, naming the person who makes the sweets.
normal.cn: chocolatier 加上施动后缀，指做这种甜食的人。

abstract.en: Picture a dark bar snapping into even squares between two thumbs.
abstract.cn: 想象一块深色巧克力在两根拇指之间掰成整齐的方格。

abstract.en: Picture a steaming cup with a spoon of cocoa stirred in.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯冒着热气的饮料里搅进一勺可可粉。

abstract.en: Picture a winter coat in a warm brown that matches the food.
abstract.cn: 想象一件与这种食物同色的暖褐色冬衣。

examples.en: She keeps a square of chocolate for the walk home.
examples.cn: 她留着一小块巧克力，走路回家时吃。

examples.en: The shop sells chocolates with orange filling.
examples.cn: 这家店卖带橙味夹心的巧克力糖。

examples.en: His coat was a deep chocolate brown.
examples.cn: 他的外套是深巧克力褐色。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cho 想成「稠」，co 想成「可」，late 想成「拉特」：稠稠的可可拉着丝，就是巧克力。

root: 源自纳瓦特尔语 xocolatl（苦涩的可可饮料），经西班牙语 chocolate 进入英语，后由饮料转为固体甜食。

sensesIntro.en: A bitter drink becomes a sweet food, then a countable piece, and finally a colour name.
sensesIntro.cn: 苦涩的饮料先变成甜食，再变出可数的一颗，最后成为颜色名称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dark bar breaking into neat squares.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块深色排块被掰成整齐的方格。

branches.en: The solid food grew out of the old cocoa drink.
branches.cn: 这种固体甜食从旧日的可可饮料演变而来。

branches.en: Small moulded pieces make the mass countable.
branches.cn: 做成小块之后，这种食物就可以数了。

branches.en: The colour is named straight after the food.
branches.cn: 颜色直接借这种食物来命名。

branches.en: Food and piece share one word, divided only by countability.
branches.cn: 食物与单颗共用一个词，只靠可数性区分。

branches.en: The colour sense keeps the look of the food.
branches.cn: 颜色义保留了这种食物的外观。

intro.en: One borrowed noun grows a plural, two adjectives, an agent noun and a playful compound.
intro.cn: 一个借来的名词长出复数、两个形容词、一个施动名词和一个戏谑的复合词。

latinIntro.en: The word travelled from Nahuatl through Spanish, so its base is not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词从纳瓦特尔语经西班牙语传来，词基并非拉丁语。

items.example: Chocolate melts quickly in a warm hand.
items.exampleCN: 巧克力在温暖的手里化得很快。
盒子里装着十二颗巧克力糖。

items.example: The sauce was rich and chocolatey.
items.exampleCN: 这酱汁浓郁，有巧克力味。

items.example: The chocolatier opened a small shop.
items.exampleCN: 这位巧克力制作师开了一家小店。
她自称嗜食巧克力的人。
choco- 出现在 chocoholic 里。

items.meaning: a person who works with something

latinEntries.example: Xocolatl was drunk cold and unsweetened.
latinEntries.exampleCN: xocolatl 当年冷饮且不加糖。

latinEntries.example: Spanish chocolate crossed into English.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 西班牙语 chocolate 进入了英语。

definition_zh: 选择；选择权；可供选择的事物；精选的
definition_en: the act of picking one thing rather than another, the right to do so, or a range of things to pick from
core_image: 两扇并排的门，一只手伸向其中一扇
scene: 站在路口，风把两边的招牌吹得直晃。She had no choice but to wait for the next bus.
sceneCN: 这里 choice 指「选择」（第 1 个义项：从多个可能中挑出一个）；句意是她别无选择，只能等下一班车。

senses.title: The act of picking
senses.definition: the act of deciding between two or more possibilities
senses.definitionCN: 在两个或多个可能之间作出决定的行为
senses.example: The choice of a career took him a whole year.
senses.exampleCN: 他花了整整一年来选择职业。
senses.why: Old French choisir meant to see a difference, and picking grew out of that act of judging.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 choisir 本指看出差别，挑选便从这种判断中生长出来。

senses.title: The right to decide
senses.definition: the right or opportunity to decide what you want
senses.definitionCN: 决定自己想要什么的权利或机会
senses.example: You have a choice: pay now or pay later.
senses.exampleCN: 你有选择权：现在付还是以后再付。
senses.why: If two things are seen as different, the power to decide between them becomes something a person owns.
senses.whyCN: 一旦两样东西被看作不同，在两者之间决定的能力便成了人所拥有之物。

senses.title: A range to pick from
senses.definition: a range of things from which one may be picked
senses.definitionCN: 可供挑选的一组事物
senses.example: The shop offers a wide choice of teas.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店可供挑选的茶叶种类很多。
senses.why: The noun then named the whole set that waits to be judged.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词随后指等待被挑选的整个集合。

intro.en: Choice comes from an Old French verb that meant to see a difference.
intro.cn: choice 源出一个意为「看出差别」的古法语动词。

items.en: A Germanic root meant to perceive or to test.
items.cn: 一个日耳曼语词根意为察觉或检验。

items.en: Choisir meant to see the difference between things.
items.cn: choisir 意为看出事物之间的差别。

items.en: Chois named both the act and the result of choosing.
items.cn: chois 既指挑选的行为，也指挑选的结果。

items.en: English choice kept the act and the right to act.
items.cn: 英语 choice 保留了这一行为以及行动的权利。

items.en: The word widened to a range of goods and to the sense of select quality.
items.cn: 词义扩展到一批商品，也扩展出「精选优质」的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the ch sound, while the meaning group names ways of deciding.
note.cn: 形近组共享 ch 音，近义组列出表示决定的各种说法。

entries.definition: to pick one thing from several
to be unable to breathe
the sound a person makes when speaking
one of the things you can pick
a range of things to pick from
another possibility instead of the first one
entries.definitionCN: 替代第一个的另一种可能

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the look-alike voice, the range sense and the three fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用形近词 voice、种类义以及三个固定搭配。

normal.en: Choice and voice differ by one letter: with a voice you dare to make a choice.
normal.cn: choice 与 voice 只差一个字母：有了声音，才敢做出选择。

normal.en: Make a choice, have no choice, by choice: three phrases cover act, lack and will.
normal.cn: make a choice、have no choice、by choice，三个搭配分别覆盖行为、被迫与自愿。

normal.en: A wide choice means a large range waiting on the shelf.
normal.cn: a wide choice 指货架上等着被挑的一大片。

normal.en: Choice meat is the best cut, so the adjective means select quality.
normal.cn: choice meat 是最好的一块肉，于是形容词义为精选优质。

normal.en: The verb is choose, the noun is choice, and the adjective is choosy.
normal.cn: 动词是 choose，名词是 choice，形容词是 choosy。

abstract.en: Picture two closed doors side by side and one hand already on a handle.
abstract.cn: 想象两扇并排关着的门，一只手已经按在把手上。

abstract.en: Picture a long shelf of teas, each tin a little different.
abstract.cn: 想象一长排茶叶罐，每一罐都略有不同。

abstract.en: Picture a butcher pointing to the finest cut on the board.
abstract.cn: 想象肉铺老板指着案板上最好的一块肉。

examples.en: You made the right choice.
examples.cn: 你作出了正确的选择。

examples.en: The menu gives guests a choice of three soups.
examples.cn: 菜单给客人三种汤可选。

examples.en: She chose the cheaper one, and the choice pleased her.
examples.cn: 她挑了便宜的那一个，这个选择让她满意。

dict_mnemonic.text: choice 与 voice 只差一个字母：先有发声的勇气，才有选择的机会。

root: 源自日耳曼语词根，经古法语 choisir（辨别、挑选）与名词 chois 进入英语，本义是看出事物之间的差别。

sensesIntro.en: Seeing a difference gives the act of picking, then the right to pick, and finally the whole range offered.
sensesIntro.cn: 看出差别先给出挑选的行为，再给出挑选的权利，最后指摆出的整个范围。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching for one of two offered objects.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸向摆出的两样东西中的一样。

branches.en: The act of picking is the first meaning of the noun.
branches.cn: 挑选的行为是这个名词的第一层意思。

branches.en: The same noun then names the power behind the act.
branches.cn: 同一个名词随后指这个行为背后的权力。

branches.en: The set of goods on offer takes the name last.
branches.cn: 摆出来供选的那批货物最后得到这个名称。

branches.en: Act and right share one word in everyday speech.
branches.cn: 在日常说法里，行为与权利共用一个词。

branches.en: A wide choice means both freedom and plenty.
branches.cn: a wide choice 同时意味着自由与充足。

intro.en: The base noun choice grows a plural, an adjective and a related verb family.
intro.cn: 名词词基 choice 长出复数、一个形容词以及一组相关动词。

latinIntro.en: Old French choisir stands behind choice, and the same stem produced choose and chosen.
latinIntro.cn: 古法语 choisir 是 choice 的前身，同一词干还生出 choose 与 chosen。

items.example: Her choices shaped the whole team.
items.exampleCN: 她的选择塑造了整个团队。

items.meaning: the state of being hard to please

items.exampleCN: 你可以挑任何一个座位。

items.example: Choosing a school is never easy.
The chosen design was very simple.
items.exampleCN: 被选中的设计非常简洁。

latinEntries.meaning: to see a difference and pick
latinEntries.example: Choisir is the direct source of choice.
latinEntries.exampleCN: choisir 是 choice 的直接来源。

definition_en: to be unable to breathe because something blocks the throat, to block a passage, or to lose the voice with strong feeling
core_image: 一只手按住喉咙，气卡在中间上不来
scene: 餐桌旁忽然静了，孩子捂着喉咙站起来。He began to choke on a piece of bread.
sceneCN: 这里 choke 指「噎住」（第 1 个义项：有东西卡在喉咙而无法呼吸）；句意是他被一块面包噎住了。

derivatives.zh: 令人窒息的东西；贴颈项链

senses.title: To block the throat
senses.definition: to be unable to breathe because something blocks the throat
senses.definitionCN: 因有东西堵住喉咙而无法呼吸
senses.example: He began to choke on a fish bone.
senses.exampleCN: 他被一根鱼刺噎住了。
senses.why: The Old English word named the jaw and the throat, the very place where breath is stopped.
senses.whyCN: 古英语这个词指颌与喉，正是呼吸被阻断的地方。

senses.title: To block a passage
senses.definition: to block or fill a passage so that things cannot move through
senses.definitionCN: 堵住通道，使东西无法通过
senses.example: Weeds choked the narrow channel.
senses.exampleCN: 杂草堵塞了狭窄的水道。
senses.why: A blocked throat and a blocked channel share the same image of something jammed tight.
senses.whyCN: 喉咙被堵与通道被堵共享同一个死死卡住的意象。

senses.title: To lose the voice with feeling
senses.definition: to be unable to speak clearly because of strong feeling
senses.definitionCN: 因情绪强烈而说不清话
senses.example: She choked back her tears and went on.
senses.exampleCN: 她强忍眼泪继续说了下去。
senses.why: Tears tighten the throat, so the word for the throat came to mean speech stopped by feeling.
senses.whyCN: 泪水使喉咙发紧，于是这个喉咙词也指被情绪堵住的话。

intro.en: Choke began as an Old English word for the jaw and the throat.
intro.cn: choke 原本是古英语中指颌与喉的词。

items.en: A root keuk- named the jaw and the swallowing throat.
items.cn: 词根 keuk- 指颌骨与吞咽的喉咙。

items.en: Aceocian meant to choke, beside ceoce for the jaw.
items.cn: aceocian 意为窒息，旁边还有 ceoce 指颌。

items.en: Choken narrowed to the stoppage of breath.
items.cn: choken 的词义收窄为呼吸受阻。

items.en: The same verb spread to blocked pipes and blocked roads.
items.cn: 同一个动词扩展到堵塞的管道与道路。

items.en: The throat image produced the sense of speech stopped by emotion.
items.cn: 喉咙的意象又生出被情绪堵住话的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the ch sound, while the meaning group names ways of stopping breath.
note.cn: 形近组共享 ch 音，近义组列出各种使呼吸停滞的说法。

entries.definition: the soft side of the face below the eye
entries.definitionCN: 眼睛下方柔软的面部侧面

entries.definition: a group of people who sing together
a building used for Christian worship
entries.definitionCN: 用于基督教礼拜的建筑

entries.definition: to die or suffer from lack of air
to kill by pressing hard on the throat
to choke and nearly vomit

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the jaw origin, the throat image and the three everyday phrase families.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用颌骨来源、喉咙意象以及三组日常搭配。

normal.en: Choke and cheek are cousins: the throat that chokes sits right beside the cheek.
normal.cn: choke 与 cheek 是亲戚：噎住的喉咙就在脸颊旁边。

normal.en: Choke on food, choke back tears, choke off supplies: the particle shows what is blocked.
normal.cn: choke on food、choke back tears、choke off supplies，小品词标出被堵住的东西。

normal.en: A choked voice is a throat tightened by feeling, not by food.
normal.cn: a choked voice 是被情绪而非食物勒紧的喉咙。

normal.en: A drain choked with leaves repeats the blocked channel sense exactly.
normal.cn: a drain choked with leaves 完全重复了通道堵塞那一义。

normal.en: The noun choke names the sound and the valve that cuts off air.
normal.cn: 名词 choke 指那种声音，也指截断空气的阀门。

abstract.en: Picture a hand rising to a throat in the middle of a meal.
abstract.cn: 想象吃饭吃到一半，一只手猛地捂上喉咙。

abstract.en: Picture weeds packed so tight that water cannot pass.
abstract.cn: 想象杂草挤得密不透风，水一点也过不去。

abstract.en: Picture a speaker stopping mid sentence with shining eyes.
abstract.cn: 想象说话的人眼睛发亮，话说到一半停住。

examples.en: The thick smoke made him choke.
examples.cn: 浓烟呛得他喘不上气。

examples.en: Anger choked his words for a moment.
examples.cn: 愤怒让他一时说不出话。

examples.en: The drain was choked with wet leaves.
examples.cn: 排水口被湿叶子堵住了。

dict_mnemonic.text: choke 与 cheek 同源：卡住的正是紧挨脸颊的那段喉咙。

root: 源自古英语 aceocian（窒息），与 ceoce（颌、颊）同源，本指喉咙被堵住而无法呼吸。

sensesIntro.en: A blocked throat gives the bodily sense, which spreads to blocked passages and then to speech stopped by feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: 喉咙被堵给出身体义，随后扩展到堵塞的通道，再扩展到被情绪堵住的话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: breath stuck halfway down a narrowed throat.
core.cn: 核心意象：一口气卡在收窄的喉咙中间。

branches.en: Food in the throat stops the breath at once.
branches.cn: 食物卡在喉里，呼吸立刻停住。

branches.en: Pipes and roads repeat the same jam on a larger scale.
branches.cn: 管道与道路把同一种堵塞放大到更大范围。

branches.en: Tears press on the throat until words fail.
branches.cn: 泪水压住喉咙，直到话语出不来。

branches.en: Body and feeling both tighten the same passage.
branches.cn: 身体与情绪收紧的是同一条通道。

branches.en: Throat and channel share one verb of blocking.
branches.cn: 喉咙与通道共用一个表示堵塞的动词。

intro.en: The short stem choke carries the verb, its inflections and two compound nouns.
intro.cn: 短词干 choke 支撑动词、各种屈折形式以及两个复合名词。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, not Latin: Old English ceoce for the jaw lies behind it.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根属日耳曼语而非拉丁语，背后是古英语 ceoce（颌）。

items.example: He chokes whenever he eats too fast.
items.exampleCN: 他每次吃得太快都会噎住。

items.example: The dust was choking the workers.
items.exampleCN: 灰尘呛得工人喘不过气。

items.meaning: a thing that chokes or a tight necklace
items.meaningCN: 令人窒息之物或贴颈项链
items.exampleCN: 她戴着一条黑色贴颈项链。

items.meaning: a thing or person that acts

latinEntries.example: Ceoce is the old jaw word behind choke.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ceoce 是 choke 背后的古颌骨词。

definition_en: to pick one thing from a group, to decide to do something, or to prefer one thing to another
core_image: 一只手伸向一堆果子里的一颗
scene: 桌上摆着两封录取通知，她迟迟没有动手。In the end she chose the smaller college.
sceneCN: 这里 chose 是 choose 的过去式，指「选择」（第 1 个义项：从多个可能中挑出一个）；句意是她最终选了那所较小的学院。

collocations.zh: 在两个工作之间作选择

senses.title: To pick from several
senses.definition: to decide which one you want from a group of things
senses.definitionCN: 从一组东西中决定要哪一个
senses.example: She chose a red scarf from the rack.
senses.exampleCN: 她从架子上挑了一条红围巾。
senses.why: Old English ceosan meant to test and approve, and approval grew into the act of picking.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 ceosan 意为检验并认可，认可之后便成了挑选。

senses.title: To decide to act
senses.definition: to decide to do something after thinking about it
senses.definitionCN: 思考之后决定做某事
senses.example: He chose to walk home alone.
senses.exampleCN: 他决定一个人走回家。
senses.why: Picking an action rather than an object turned the verb into a verb of decision.
senses.whyCN: 挑的是一个动作而不是一件东西，于是这个动词也成了表示决定的词。

senses.title: To prefer one side
senses.definition: to prefer one thing or person to another
senses.definitionCN: 比起另一样更偏爱某物或某人
senses.example: You may choose tea over coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 你可以选茶而不选咖啡。
senses.why: Comparison sharpens the sense until the verb means to favour one side.
senses.whyCN: 比较使词义更鲜明，直到这个动词表示偏向一方。

intro.en: Choose goes back to an Old English verb meaning to test and approve.
intro.cn: choose 可上溯到一个意为检验并认可的古英语动词。

items.en: The root keus- meant to taste and judge.
items.cn: 词根 keus- 意为品尝并判断。

items.en: Ceosan meant to test something and find it good.
items.cn: ceosan 意为检验某物并认为它好。

items.en: Chesen moved the stress to the act of picking.
items.cn: chesen 把重心移到挑选这个动作上。

items.en: The modern spelling choose settled beside chose and chosen.
items.cn: 现代拼写 choose 与 chose、chosen 一并固定下来。

items.en: The verb widened from objects to actions and to open preference.
items.cn: 这个动词从挑选物件扩展到决定行动与公开的偏爱。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the ch spelling, while the meaning group names acts of selection.
note.cn: 形近组共享 ch 拼写，近义组列出各种挑选的动作。

entries.definition: the act or right of picking
to run after someone to catch them
a solid food made from milk
entries.definitionCN: 用牛奶制成的固体食物

entries.definition: to pick the most suitable one
to choose one from a group
to make a choice between possibilities
entries.definitionCN: 在多种可能中作出选择

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the choice family, the irregular past forms and the three sentence patterns.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 choice 词族、不规则过去式以及三种句型。

normal.en: Choose is the verb, choice is the noun, and chosen is the finished result.
normal.cn: choose 是动词，choice 是名词，chosen 是完成后的结果。

normal.en: The past is chose and the participle is chosen, so the long oo shortens once.
normal.cn: 过去式是 chose，过去分词是 chosen，长音 oo 会缩短一次。

normal.en: Choose between, choose from, choose to: three frames cover things, lists and actions.
normal.cn: choose between、choose from、choose to，三种框架覆盖事物、清单与动作。

normal.en: Pick and choose is the critical phrase, meaning to reject most of what is offered.
normal.cn: pick and choose 是挑剔的说法，意为把摆出来的大部分都拒掉。

normal.en: A chooser acts, while a choosy person is hard to satisfy.
normal.cn: chooser 指做选择的人，choosy 则指难以满足的人。

abstract.en: Picture fingers hovering over a bowl of fruit before closing on one.
abstract.cn: 想象手指在一碗果子上面停住，最后捏住其中一颗。

abstract.en: Picture two letters on a table and a long silence above them.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上两封信，上方是一段长长的沉默。

abstract.en: Picture a hand lifting one book out of a crowded shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手从拥挤的书架上抽出一本书。

examples.en: You can choose any colour you like.
examples.cn: 你可以挑任何喜欢的颜色。

examples.en: They chose him as captain of the team.
examples.cn: 他们选他当队长。

examples.en: Choosing is easier when the list is short.
examples.cn: 清单短的时候，挑选就容易些。

dict_mnemonic.text: choose 里藏着两个 o：两眼一扫，就把想要的那一个挑出来。

root: 源自古英语 ceosan（检验、挑选），属日耳曼语族，与德语 kiesen 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Testing and approving gives the act of picking, which extends to deciding on an action and then to open preference.
sensesIntro.cn: 检验并认可先给出挑选的行为，再扩展到决定行动，最后扩展到公开的偏爱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fingers closing on one fruit out of many.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指在许多果子里捏住其中一颗。

branches.en: Testing an object and taking it is the first sense.
branches.cn: 检验一件东西并把它拿走，是第一层意思。

branches.en: The object can be an action, so the verb means to decide.
branches.cn: 被挑的可以是一个动作，于是这个动词表示决定。

branches.en: Two things compared produce the sense of preference.
branches.cn: 两样东西一经比较，就生出偏爱的意思。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a quiet moment of judgement.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个安静的判断时刻。

branches.en: Deciding and preferring often appear together.
branches.cn: 决定与偏爱常常一起出现。

intro.en: One Old English stem yields the verb choose, its irregular forms and the noun choice.
intro.cn: 一个古英语词干生出动词 choose、它的不规则形式以及名词 choice。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Germanic; Old English ceosan is its earliest recorded shape.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词干属日耳曼语，古英语 ceosan 是其最早有记录的形式。

items.example: Choose a seat near the window.
She chooses her words with care.
She is choosing a dress now.
The chooser must live with the result.
items.exampleCN: 做选择的人必须承担结果。

items.meaning: the act or right of picking

latinEntries.example: Ceosan is the oldest recorded shape of choose.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ceosan 是 choose 最早有记录的形式。

definition_en: to cut something with a heavy blow, to cut food into small pieces, or a small piece of meat cut with a rib
core_image: 一把菜刀落在砧板上，把肉剁成两半
scene: 厨房里飘着洋葱味，砧板响个不停。She chopped the onions into small pieces.
sceneCN: 这里 chopped 是 chop 的过去式，指「切碎」（第 2 个义项：把食物切成小块）；句意是她把洋葱切成了小块。

senses.title: To cut with a heavy blow
senses.definition: to cut something with a heavy blow from an axe or a large knife
senses.definitionCN: 用斧头或大刀重重砍下
senses.example: He chopped the branch off the tree.
senses.exampleCN: 他把那根树枝从树上砍了下来。
senses.why: Middle English choppen imitated the short heavy sound of a blade striking wood.
senses.whyCN: 中古英语 choppen 模仿刀刃击木时短促沉重的声音。

senses.title: To cut food small
senses.definition: to cut food into small pieces with quick heavy blows
senses.definitionCN: 用快速有力的刀法把食物切成小块
senses.example: She chopped the onions into small pieces.
senses.exampleCN: 她把洋葱切成了小块。
senses.why: The same short blow moved from firewood to the kitchen board.
senses.whyCN: 同样短促的砍击从木柴移到了厨房砧板。

senses.title: A piece of meat on a rib
senses.definition: a small piece of meat cut together with a rib bone
senses.definitionCN: 带肋骨一起切下的一小块肉
senses.example: We had lamb chops for dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 我们晚饭吃了羊排。
senses.why: A chop is literally a piece chopped off the carcass.
senses.whyCN: chop 字面上就是从整只牲畜身上剁下来的一块。

intro.en: Chop probably began as a sound word for a short heavy blow.
intro.cn: chop 最初很可能是一个模仿短促沉重砍击的拟声词。

items.en: The shape of the word echoes a blade striking wood.
items.cn: 这个词的声音模仿刀刃击木。

items.en: Choppen meant to cut with repeated heavy blows.
items.cn: choppen 意为用反复的重击来砍。

items.en: The verb spread from firewood to meat and vegetables.
items.cn: 这个动词从木柴扩展到肉类与蔬菜。

items.en: The noun named a rib piece cut off the carcass.
items.cn: 名词指从整只牲畜上剁下的带骨肉块。

items.en: Compounds gave chopsticks, chopper and the adjective choppy.
items.cn: 复合构词又生出 chopsticks、chopper 与形容词 choppy。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the short ch spelling, while the meaning group names ways of cutting.
note.cn: 形近组保持短促的 ch 拼写，近义组列出各种切割方式。

entries.definition: a small piece broken off something
a place where goods are sold
to crack or redden from cold
to divide something with a blade
to cut into thin flat pieces
to cut food into very small bits
entries.definitionCN: 把食物切成极小的碎末

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the sound of the blade, the kitchen board and the meat sense.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用刀声、厨房砧板以及排骨义。

normal.en: Say chop twice quickly and you hear an axe on a log.
normal.cn: 快速连说两次 chop，就听见斧头落在木头上的声音。

normal.en: Chop wood is the wood sense, chop onions is the kitchen sense, and both are short blows.
normal.cn: chop wood 是劈柴义，chop onions 是厨房义，两者都是短促的砍击。

normal.en: A pork chop is a piece chopped off, so the noun keeps the verb image.
normal.cn: a pork chop 就是剁下来的一块，名词保留了动词的意象。

normal.en: Chop down adds down, and the tree falls in the direction of the blow.
normal.cn: chop down 加上 down，树便朝砍击的方向倒下。

normal.en: Chopsticks and chopper both start from the same short stem.
normal.cn: chopsticks 与 chopper 都从同一个短词干出发。

abstract.en: Picture a blade biting into a log with a dull thud.
abstract.cn: 想象刀刃咬进木头，发出一声闷响。

abstract.en: Picture a board covered with neat piles of diced onion.
abstract.cn: 想象砧板上是一小堆一小堆切好的洋葱丁。

abstract.en: Picture a thick chop bone showing at the edge of the meat.
abstract.cn: 想象肉块边缘露出一截粗大的骨头。

examples.en: He chopped wood for the fire all morning.
examples.cn: 他整个上午都在劈柴生火。

examples.en: Add two chopped carrots to the pot.
examples.cn: 往锅里加两根切碎的胡萝卜。

examples.en: The pork chop was thick and juicy.
examples.cn: 那块猪排又厚又多汁。

dict_mnemonic.text: chop 读起来就像刀落砧板的一声：剁。

root: 源自中古英语 choppen（砍、剁），可能模仿刀斧砍击的声音，与 chap 相关。

sensesIntro.en: A short heavy blow gives the cutting sense, which moves to the kitchen and then to the piece of meat cut off.
sensesIntro.cn: 短促的重击先给出砍的动作，再移到厨房，最后指剁下来的那块肉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a blade falling once on a wooden board.
core.cn: 核心意象：刀刃在木板上落下一次。

branches.en: The axe sense is the oldest and the most physical.
branches.cn: 斧头义最古老，也最具体。

branches.en: The same blow works on onions and carrots.
branches.cn: 同样的砍击用在洋葱与胡萝卜上。

branches.en: The noun names the piece that the blow leaves.
branches.cn: 名词指这一刀之后留下的那块肉。

branches.en: Wood and food share one verb of short strokes.
branches.cn: 木柴与食物共用一个短促下刀的动词。

branches.en: The cut food and the cut meat sit side by side.
branches.cn: 切好的菜与剁下的肉彼此相邻。

intro.en: The short stem chop carries the verb, its inflections and three familiar compounds.
intro.cn: 短词干 chop 支撑动词、各种屈折形式以及三个常见复合词。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic and partly imitative, so no Latin root is involved.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语且带拟声成分，不涉及拉丁词根。

items.meaning: to cut with a heavy blow

items.example: The chopper hung by the stove.
The lake was choppy that day.
He ate the noodles with chopsticks.

items.meaning: a tool or person that acts

latinEntries.example: Choppen is the recorded source of chop.
latinEntries.exampleCN: choppen 是 chop 有记录的来源。

definition_en: a building where Christians worship, the whole body of Christians, or a service held in such a building
core_image: 村庄屋顶上方立着的一座尖顶钟楼
scene: 钟声从村口传来，人们沿着石阶往里走。The old church stands at the end of the lane.
sceneCN: 这里 church 指「教堂」（第 1 个义项：基督徒礼拜的建筑）；句意是那座老教堂立在小巷的尽头。

senses.title: A Christian building
senses.definition: a building where Christians meet for worship
senses.definitionCN: 基督徒聚会礼拜的建筑
senses.example: The old church stands at the end of the lane.
senses.exampleCN: 那座老教堂立在小巷的尽头。
senses.why: Greek kyriakon meant the house of the Lord, and the building took that name.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 kyriakon 意为「主的房屋」，这座建筑便得了这个名字。

senses.title: The body of believers
senses.definition: the whole group of Christians, or one branch of that group
senses.definitionCN: 全体基督徒，或其中的一个分支
senses.example: The church has spoken against the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 教会已公开反对这项计划。
senses.why: A house of worship also named the people who gathered inside it.
senses.whyCN: 礼拜的场所也用来指在其中聚集的人。

senses.title: A service of worship
senses.definition: a formal service of worship held in a church
senses.definitionCN: 在教堂举行的正式礼拜仪式
senses.example: They go to church every Sunday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们每个星期日都去做礼拜。
senses.why: Going to the building became a name for the act performed there.
senses.whyCN: 去那座建筑，逐渐成了在那里举行的仪式的名称。

intro.en: Church descends from a Greek phrase meaning the house of the Lord.
intro.cn: church 源出一个意为「主的房屋」的希腊语说法。

items.en: Kyriakon meant the house belonging to the Lord.
items.cn: kyriakon 意为属于主的房屋。

items.en: The word travelled north as kirika among Germanic speakers.
items.cn: 这个词以 kirika 的形式在日耳曼语族群中向北传播。

items.en: Cirice named the building and the community together.
items.cn: cirice 同时指建筑与群体。

items.en: Chirche settled into the modern sound and spelling.
items.cn: chirche 固定为现代的读音与拼写。

items.en: The word keeps building, body and service side by side.
items.cn: 这个词同时保留建筑、群体与仪式三层意思。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the ch opening, while the meaning group names other places of worship.
note.cn: 形近组保持 ch 开头，近义组列出其他礼拜场所。

entries.definition: a small building or room used for worship
entries.definitionCN: 用于礼拜的小建筑或小房间

entries.definition: a small round red fruit with a stone
a small routine task about the house
a building used for the worship of a god
a building where Muslims worship
the people gathered for worship

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Greek house phrase, the three senses and the Sunday phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用希腊语「主的房屋」、三层意思以及星期日搭配。

normal.en: Church is the house of the Lord, so the building came first and the people came second.
normal.cn: church 是主的房屋，所以建筑义在先，人群义在后。

normal.en: Go to church uses no article, because it names the service rather than the building.
normal.cn: go to church 不加冠词，因为它指的是礼拜而不是建筑。

normal.en: The church can mean one branch, as in the Catholic Church.
normal.cn: the church 可以指一个分支，例如 the Catholic Church。

normal.en: Churchyard and churchgoer keep the old stem whole.
normal.cn: churchyard 与 churchgoer 都完整保留了旧词干。

normal.en: Churches adds es, since the stem already ends in ch.
normal.cn: 复数加 es，因为词干本身以 ch 结尾。

abstract.en: Picture a stone tower lifting a bell above village roofs.
abstract.cn: 想象一座石塔把钟举在村庄屋顶之上。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd standing together in a cool stone hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人一起站在凉爽的石砌大厅里。

abstract.en: Picture a family walking up steps on a quiet Sunday.
abstract.cn: 想象一家人在安静的星期日走上台阶。

examples.en: The church bells rang across the valley.
examples.cn: 教堂的钟声传遍山谷。

examples.en: The church has run the school for a hundred years.
examples.cn: 教会办这所学校已经一百年了。

examples.en: They were married in a small country church.
examples.cn: 他们在一座乡村小教堂里结了婚。

dict_mnemonic.text: church 与 circle 都以 ch 开头：钟声一圈圈绕着教堂传开。

root: 源自希腊语 kyriakon（主的房屋），经日耳曼语 kirika 进入古英语作 cirice，本指基督徒礼拜的场所。

sensesIntro.en: The house of the Lord gives the building, then the people who gather there, then the service they perform.
sensesIntro.cn: 「主的房屋」先给出建筑，再给出在其中聚集的人，最后给出他们举行的仪式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bell tower above a stone hall full of people.
core.cn: 核心意象：石砌大厅上方的钟楼，厅里坐满了人。

branches.en: The building is the earliest and most literal sense.
branches.cn: 建筑义最早，也最贴近字面。

branches.en: The people inside the house take its name.
branches.cn: 房屋里面的人接过了它的名称。

branches.en: The act done there is named by going there.
branches.cn: 去那里这件事，成了在那里举行的仪式的名称。

branches.en: Building and service are linked by the Sunday visit.
branches.cn: 建筑与仪式由星期日的到访连在一起。

branches.en: A body of believers gathers for one service.
branches.cn: 一群信徒聚在一起参加同一场礼拜。

intro.en: The stem church builds a plural, two compounds and an adjective.
intro.cn: 词干 church 构成复数、两个复合词和一个形容词。

latinIntro.en: Greek kyriakon reaches English through Germanic, not through Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 kyriakon 是经日耳曼语而非拉丁语进入英语的。

items.example: The church was built in stone.
items.exampleCN: 这座教堂是用石头建的。

items.example: Three churches stand on the hill.
An old yew grows in the churchyard.
items.exampleCN: 教堂墓地里长着一棵老紫杉。

items.meaning: a man who serves the church
items.example: The churchman spoke after the service.
items.exampleCN: 这位教士在礼拜后发言。

items.example: The hall had a churchly calm.
items.exampleCN: 大厅有一种教堂般的宁静。

latinEntries.example: Kyriakon is the remote source of church.
latinEntries.exampleCN: kyriakon 是 church 的远源词。

definition_en: a thick roll of tobacco leaves made for smoking, or the cured leaf tobacco used to make it
core_image: 两根手指夹着一支粗大的褐色烟卷
scene: 阳台上有人靠着栏杆，烟雾慢慢散开。He lit a cigar and watched the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 cigar 指「雪茄」（第 1 个义项：用整片烟叶卷成的粗烟）；句意是他点着一支雪茄，望着港口。

senses.title: A roll of tobacco leaf
senses.definition: a thick roll of whole tobacco leaves made for smoking
senses.definitionCN: 用整片烟叶卷成、供吸食的粗烟
senses.example: He lit a cigar after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 他饭后点了一支雪茄。
senses.why: Spanish cigarro first named a rolled bundle of tobacco leaves.
senses.whyCN: 西班牙语 cigarro 最初指卷起来的一捆烟叶。

senses.title: Leaf tobacco for cigars
senses.definition: the cured leaf tobacco used to make cigars
senses.definitionCN: 用于制作雪茄的晾制烟叶
senses.example: The valley grows tobacco for cigars.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷种植制作雪茄用的烟叶。
senses.why: The raw leaf and the finished roll shared one name in the trade.
senses.whyCN: 在行业里，原料烟叶与卷好的成品共用一个名称。

intro.en: Cigar may come from a Mayan word for smoking rolled leaves.
intro.cn: cigar 可能源自玛雅语中表示吸卷叶的词。

items.en: Sicar referred to smoking rolled tobacco leaves.
items.cn: sicar 指吸食卷起的烟叶。

items.en: Cigarro named a thick roll of tobacco leaf.
items.cn: cigarro 指用烟叶卷成的粗烟卷。

items.en: Cigare carried the word into French salons.
items.cn: cigare 把这个词带进法国上流社交圈。

items.en: English cigar kept the thicker final r sound.
items.cn: 英语 cigar 保留了词尾较重的 r 音。

items.en: The word then named the leaf material as well as the roll.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the cigarette contrast, the leaf material and the smoking phrases.

normal.en: Cigar is the thick one and cigarette is the thin one, split by a small suffix.
normal.cn: cigar 是粗的那支，cigarette 是细的那支，两者靠一个指小后缀区分。

normal.en: Cigar ends in a hard r, and that r marks the larger roll.

normal.en: Smoke a cigar, light a cigar, a box of cigars: three phrases from one noun.
normal.cn: smoke a cigar、light a cigar、a box of cigars，一个名词支撑三个搭配。

normal.en: Cigar tobacco is the raw leaf, cigar smoke is what the leaf gives off.

intro.en: The stem cigar builds a plural, a diminutive, two compounds and a shape adjective.

core_image: 两根手指间一支细白的纸卷，端头亮着红点

senses.title: A thin paper roll of tobacco
senses.definition: a thin roll of cut tobacco wrapped in paper for smoking

senses.why: French added a small suffix to cigare, and the small cigar became a paper roll.

senses.title: Smoke from a burning roll

intro.en: Cigarette is simply a small cigar, built with a French diminutive suffix.

items.en: Cigarro named a roll of tobacco leaf.
items.cn: cigarro 指卷起的烟叶。

items.en: Cigare entered French from Spanish.
items.cn: cigare 从西班牙语进入法语。

items.en: Cigarette added -ette and meant a small cigar.
items.cn: cigarette 加上 -ette，意为小雪茄。

items.en: English borrowed it for the paper-wrapped roll.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词，用来指纸裹的烟卷。

items.cn: 机器卷制让这种细烟卷成了日常物品。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the diminutive suffix, the pair with cigar and the daily phrases.

normal.en: Cigarette is cigar plus a small suffix, so it looks and sounds lighter.
normal.cn: cigarette 就是 cigar 加一个指小后缀，样子和读音都更轻。

normal.en: The stress falls on the last syllable, ret, which keeps the small word lively.
normal.cn: 重音落在最后一个音节 ret 上，让这个小词显得轻快。

normal.en: Smoke a cigarette, light a cigarette, stub out a cigarette: three stages of one act.
normal.cn: smoke a cigarette、light a cigarette、stub out a cigarette，是同一动作的三个阶段。

normal.en: A pack of cigarettes shows the plural, while cigarette smoke stays uncountable.

normal.en: The short forms cig and ciggie drop the long ending in casual speech.
normal.cn: 口语里 cig 与 ciggie 把长长的词尾省掉了。

abstract.en: Picture a small white roll glowing at one end in a doorway.

abstract.en: Picture a hand shielding a flame from the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手挡住风，护着那一点火苗。

abstract.en: Picture grey ash tapped into a metal tray.
abstract.cn: 想象灰色的烟灰被弹进金属盘里。

examples.en: He stepped outside to smoke a cigarette.
examples.cn: 他走到外面去抽一支香烟。

examples.en: A pack of cigarettes sat on the table.
examples.cn: 桌上放着一包香烟。

examples.en: Cigarette smoke hung in the still air.
examples.cn: 香烟的烟滞留在静止的空气里。

dict_mnemonic.text: cigarette 比 cigar 多了一个指小词尾：细一点，小一点。

root: 由法语 cigare（雪茄）加指小后缀 -ette 构成，十九世纪进入英语，本义是「小雪茄」。

sensesIntro.en: A small cigar becomes the paper roll, and the burning roll lends its name to the smoke.
sensesIntro.cn: 「小雪茄」先变成纸卷烟，燃烧的烟卷又把名字借给了它的烟。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin white roll with a red tip.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支端头泛红的细白烟卷。

branches.en: The thin paper roll is the central sense.
branches.cn: 细纸卷是核心义项。

branches.en: The smoke carries the same name in daily talk.
branches.cn: 在日常说法里，烟也带着同一个名字。

branches.en: Roll and smoke appear together in one breath.

branches.en: The suffix marks the smaller size of the roll.

branches.en: The smoke is what remains after the roll burns.
branches.cn: 烟是烟卷燃尽之后留下的东西。

intro.en: The stem builds a plural, two clippings and a compound, all from the same base.
intro.cn: 这个词干构成复数、两个缩略形式和一个复合词，都出自同一词基。

latinIntro.en: The base cigare is French, and the suffix -ette is a French diminutive.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 cigare 属法语，后缀 -ette 也是法语指小成分。

definition_en: a building where films are shown, films as an art form, or a single showing of a film
core_image: 暗厅里一束光穿过浮尘打在银幕上
scene: 灯一暗，屏幕上的画面慢慢亮起来。We went to the cinema on a rainy afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 cinema 指「电影院」（第 1 个义项：放映电影的场所）；句意是我们在一个下雨的午后去了电影院。

derivatives.zh: 电影的；电影般有感染力的

senses.title: A place showing films
senses.definition: a building where films are shown to the public
senses.definitionCN: 向公众放映电影的场所
senses.example: We went to the cinema on a rainy afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在一个下雨的午后去了电影院。
senses.why: The French name of the moving picture machine was shortened, and the hall that used it took the short form.
senses.whyCN: 法语中那台活动影像机器的名字被缩短，使用它的厅堂便用了这个短形式。

senses.title: Films as an art
senses.definition: films considered as an art form or as an industry
senses.definitionCN: 被视为艺术形式或产业的电影
senses.example: He has worked in the cinema for thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他在电影界工作了三十年。
senses.why: The name of the machine widened from the device to the art it produced.
senses.whyCN: 那台机器的名字从装置扩展到它所创造的艺术。

senses.title: A single film showing
senses.definition: one showing of a film at a fixed time
senses.definitionCN: 在固定时间放映的一场电影
senses.example: The evening cinema starts at eight.
senses.exampleCN: 晚场电影八点开始。
senses.why: The place and the event shared one noun, as with many public buildings.
senses.whyCN: 场所与活动共用一个名词，许多公共建筑都是如此。

intro.en: Cinema is a short form of the French name for a machine that recorded movement.
intro.cn: cinema 是一个法语名字的缩短形式，那台机器专门记录运动。

items.en: Kinema meant movement.
items.cn: kinema 意为运动。

items.en: Cinematographe named a machine that photographed movement.
items.cn: cinematographe 指拍摄运动影像的机器。

items.en: English shortened the long name to cinema.
items.cn: 英语把这个长名字缩短成 cinema。

items.en: The word moved from the machine to the hall and to the art.
items.cn: 这个词从机器转到厅堂，再转到艺术。

items.en: Cinema now covers the place, the showing and the industry.
items.cn: cinema 现在覆盖场所、放映活动与整个产业。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the soft c opening, while the meaning group names places and films.
note.cn: 形近组保持柔软的 c 开头，近义组列出场所与影片。

entries.definition: a work of moving pictures with sound

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Greek movement root, the three senses and the everyday phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用希腊语「运动」词根、三层意思以及日常搭配。

normal.en: Cinema starts from the Greek word for movement, because films move.
normal.cn: cinema 出自希腊语表示运动的词，因为电影本来就是动的。

normal.en: The long machine name cinematographe was cut down, and cinema kept the middle.
normal.cn: 长长的机器名 cinematographe 被截短，cinema 留下了中间一段。

normal.en: Go to the cinema names the place, while work in the cinema names the art.
normal.cn: go to the cinema 指场所，work in the cinema 指艺术。

normal.en: Cinematic is the adjective and cinematography is the craft of the camera.
normal.cn: cinematic 是形容词，cinematography 是掌镜的技艺。

normal.en: A cinephile loves films, built from the short stem cine.
normal.cn: cinephile 是爱电影的人，由短词干 cine 构成。

abstract.en: Picture dust floating in the beam above a dark row of seats.
abstract.cn: 想象一束光里浮着灰尘，下面是一排排黑暗的座位。

abstract.en: Picture a white screen waking up with a slow picture.
abstract.cn: 想象白色银幕上缓缓浮出画面。

abstract.en: Picture a reel of film turning behind a small window.
abstract.cn: 想象一小格窗口后面转动的胶片盘。

examples.en: The cinema was almost empty that night.
examples.cn: 那晚电影院里几乎没人。

examples.en: She has written about the cinema for years.
examples.cn: 她写电影方面的文章已有多年。

examples.en: We met outside the cinema at seven.
examples.cn: 我们七点在电影院外碰面。

dict_mnemonic.text: cinema 的开头 cine 听起来像「看你」：黑暗里一群人一起看你。

root: 源自希腊语 kinema（运动），经法语 cinematographe（活动影像机）缩略为 cinema，本指放映活动影像的场所。

sensesIntro.en: A machine for movement gives its short name to the hall, then to the art and to a single showing.
sensesIntro.cn: 记录运动的机器把短名让给厅堂，再让给艺术与单场放映。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a beam of light cutting through a dark hall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一束光切过黑暗的放映厅。

branches.en: The hall is the most common everyday sense.
branches.cn: 厅堂是最常见的日常义项。

branches.en: The art sense grew from the pictures themselves.
branches.cn: 艺术义从画面本身生长出来。

branches.en: One showing is the place sense narrowed to a time.
branches.cn: 单场放映是场所义收窄到某个时段。

branches.en: A hall and its evening showing share one word.
branches.cn: 厅堂与它的晚场共用一个词。

branches.en: The building serves an art that became an industry.
branches.cn: 这座建筑服务于一种后来成为产业的艺术。

intro.en: The short stem cine supports a plural, an adjective, a craft noun and a lover compound.
intro.cn: 短词干 cine 支撑复数、形容词、技艺名词以及一个表示爱好者的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Greek kinema lies behind cinema, and -graphy adds the sense of writing or recording.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 kinema 是 cinema 的前身，-graphy 添加记录或书写的含义。

definition_en: a perfectly round closed shape, a group of people with a shared interest, or to move in a round path around something

senses.title: A round closed shape
senses.definition: a perfectly round shape whose edge is the same distance from the centre everywhere
senses.definitionCN: 边缘到中心距离处处相等的正圆形状
senses.example: He drew a circle on the board.
senses.exampleCN: 他在黑板上画了一个圆。
senses.why: Latin circulus meant a small ring, and the ring shape kept the name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circulus 指小圆环，环形这个形状保留了这个名字。

senses.title: A group of people
senses.definition: a group of people who share an interest or a way of life
senses.definitionCN: 有共同兴趣或生活方式的一群人
senses.example: She has a small circle of close friends.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一个小小的密友圈子。
senses.why: People standing in a ring around a speaker became a social group.
senses.whyCN: 围着说话人站成一圈的人，逐渐成了一群社交伙伴。

senses.title: To move around something
senses.definition: to move in a round path around something

senses.why: The noun of a ring turned into a verb of going round.
senses.whyCN: 表示圆环的名词转成了绕行的动词。

intro.en: Circle comes from the Latin word for a small ring.
intro.cn: circle 源自拉丁语中表示小圆环的词。

items.en: Circus named a ring or a circular arena.
items.cn: circus 指圆环或环形场地。

items.en: Circulus was the small ring built from circus.
items.cn: circulus 是由 circus 构成的指小形式，意为小圆环。

items.en: Cercle carried the shape word into French.
items.cn: cercle 把这个表示形状的词带进法语。

items.en: English circle named the shape and the ring of people.
items.cn: 英语 circle 兼指形状与围成圈的人群。

items.en: The noun produced a verb meaning to go round.
items.cn: 这个名词又生出表示绕行的动词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ring root, while the meaning group names round forms.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语圆环词根，近义组列出各种圆形与环状物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the circus root, the ring of people and the verb of going round.

normal.en: Circle and circus share a root: a circus is played inside a big ring.
normal.cn: circle 与 circus 同根：马戏就是在一个大圆环里演的。

normal.en: Latin circulus was a small ring, and the -cle ending still sounds small.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 circulus 是小圆环，-cle 词尾至今听起来仍显小。

normal.en: A circle of friends keeps the shape image: people standing around one centre.
normal.cn: a circle of friends 保留了形状意象：人围着一个中心站。

normal.en: The verb circles needs no preposition of direction, because the path itself is closed.
normal.cn: 动词 circle 不需要方向介词，因为路线本身就是闭合的。

normal.en: Circular, circulate and semicircle all grow from the same ring.
normal.cn: circular、circulate 与 semicircle 都从同一个圆环长出来。

abstract.en: Picture chalk travelling around and closing exactly where it began.
abstract.cn: 想象粉笔一路转过去，正好在起点合上。

abstract.en: Picture a ring of chairs with one lamp in the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈椅子，中间放着一盏灯。

abstract.en: Picture a plane leaving a pale ring above a sleeping town.
abstract.cn: 想象飞机在沉睡的城镇上空留下一圈淡痕。

examples.en: Draw a circle and mark its centre.
examples.cn: 画一个圆，并标出它的圆心。

examples.en: The discussion moved in circles for an hour.
examples.cn: 讨论绕了一个小时的圈子。

examples.en: Birds circled above the empty field.
examples.cn: 鸟在空旷的田野上方盘旋。

dict_mnemonic.text: circle 与 circus 同源：马戏场本来就是一个大圆环。

root: 源自拉丁语 circulus（小圆环），是 circus（环形场地）的指小形式，经古法语 cercle 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: A small ring gives the shape, then the ring of people, and finally the act of going round.
sensesIntro.cn: 小圆环先给出形状，再给出围成圈的人，最后给出绕行的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: chalk closing a perfect ring on a board.
core.cn: 核心意象：粉笔在黑板上合拢成一个完美的环。

branches.en: The geometric shape is the first and plainest sense.
branches.cn: 几何形状是最先也最朴素的一义。

branches.en: People arranged in a ring become a social circle.
branches.cn: 排成环的人成了一个社交圈子。

branches.en: The noun of a ring gives the verb of moving round.
branches.cn: 圆环名词给出表示绕行的动词。

branches.en: The shape and the motion share one closed path.
branches.cn: 形状与动作共享同一条闭合路线。

branches.en: A circle of friends also closes around a centre.
branches.cn: 朋友圈子同样围绕一个中心合拢。

intro.en: The stem circle builds a plural, a verb family and three Latin relatives.
intro.cn: 词干 circle 构成复数、一组动词以及三个拉丁语亲族词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circulus, a small circus, is the source of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circulus 是一个小 circus，是整个词族的来源。

items.example: The circle is ten metres across.
The stone left circles in the water.
items.exampleCN: 石头在水面留下一圈圈波纹。

items.example: The hawk circled the tower once.
The dog was circling the chair.
They sat at a circular table.
items.exampleCN: 他们围坐在一张圆桌旁。

items.meaning: a small version of the base
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -cle 出现在 circle 中。

latinEntries.example: Circulus is the direct source of circle.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circulus 是 circle 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Circus gave circulus its ring shape.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circus 赋予了 circulus 圆环的形状。

definition_en: a complete path through which electric current flows, a route that returns to its start, or a regular round of visits
core_image: 电流沿着一圈导线跑回起点
scene: 桌上摊着一块电路板，指示灯一闪一闪。A loose wire broke the circuit.
sceneCN: 这里 circuit 指「电路」（第 1 个义项：电流可以流过的闭合路径）；句意是一根松脱的导线让电路断开了。

senses.title: A closed path for current
senses.definition: a complete path through which electric current can flow
senses.definitionCN: 电流可以流过的完整路径
senses.example: A loose wire broke the circuit.
senses.exampleCN: 一根松脱的导线让电路断开了。
senses.why: Latin circuitus meant a going around, and electricity repeats that closed loop.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circuitus 意为绕行，电流重复的正是这种闭合环路。

senses.title: A circular route
senses.definition: a route that goes around and comes back to the start
senses.definitionCN: 绕一圈后回到起点的路线
senses.example: The race covers a five kilometre circuit.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛跑一圈五公里的环道。
senses.why: The going-around sense named any path that returns on itself.
senses.whyCN: 绕行的意思用来指任何自身闭合的路线。

senses.title: A regular round of visits
senses.definition: a regular series of visits to several places in turn
senses.definitionCN: 依次到多个地点的一轮例行访问
senses.example: The judge travels a country circuit.
senses.exampleCN: 这位法官在乡间巡回审案。
senses.why: Officials who rode from town to town completed a ring of visits.
senses.whyCN: 官员从一镇走到另一镇，正好走完一圈行程。

intro.en: Circuit is Latin for a going around, built from around plus to go.
intro.cn: circuit 在拉丁语中意为绕行，由「周围」与「走」两部分构成。

items.en: Circum meant around on every side.
items.cn: circum 意为四周环绕。

items.en: Ire meant to go.
items.cn: ire 意为走。

items.en: Circuitus named the act of going round.
items.cn: circuitus 指绕行这一动作。

items.en: Circuit kept the legal and travelling senses.
items.cn: circuit 保留了法律与巡行的意思。

items.en: English used circuit for a judge's round of towns.
items.cn: 英语用 circuit 指法官巡视各镇的行程。

items.en: Electricity gave the word its most familiar sense.
items.cn: 电学赋予这个词最熟悉的义项。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ring root, while the meaning group names paths and routes.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语圆环词根，近义组列出路径与路线。

entries.definition: a round closed shape
shaped like a circle
a show performed in a ring
entries.definitionCN: 在圆环场地演出的表演

entries.definition: a path that returns to itself
a way from one place to another
a line along which something moves

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two Latin parts, the electric loop and the judge's round.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用两个拉丁语部件、电流环路以及法官巡行。

normal.en: Split circuit into circu and it: a ring plus a going, so a going round.
normal.cn: 把 circuit 拆成 circu 与 it：一个圈加一次走，就是绕一圈。

normal.en: A broken circuit stops the current because the ring is no longer closed.
normal.cn: 电路断了电流就停，因为那个环不再闭合。

normal.en: Short circuit skips the long path, and short-circuit as a verb means to bypass.
normal.cn: 短路跳过了长路径，动词 short-circuit 便表示绕过。

normal.en: The racing circuit is a loop of road, and the lecture circuit is a loop of towns.
normal.cn: 赛车环道是一圈路，巡回讲学是一圈城镇。

normal.en: Circuitous keeps the going-around idea in adjective form.
normal.cn: circuitous 以形容词形式保留绕行的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a thin wire returning to the battery it left.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细导线回到它出发的那块电池。

abstract.en: Picture a car passing the same grandstand again.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆车再次经过同一座看台。

abstract.en: Picture a judge's carriage stopping in one more market square.
abstract.cn: 想象法官的马车又在另一个集市广场停下。

examples.en: Water got into the circuit and stopped the machine.
examples.cn: 水进了电路，机器停了下来。

examples.en: They drove one full circuit of the park.
examples.cn: 他们绕公园整整开了一圈。

examples.en: The band spent the summer on the festival circuit.
examples.cn: 乐队整个夏天都在音乐节巡回演出。

dict_mnemonic.text: circuit 拆成 circu 与 it：绕一圈，再走回来。

root: 源自拉丁语 circuitus（绕行），由 circum（周围）与 ire（走）构成，本指走一圈回到原处。

sensesIntro.en: A going around gives the closed path, then any returning route, and then a round of official visits.
sensesIntro.cn: 绕行先给出闭合路径，再给出任何回到原处的路线，最后给出官员的一轮巡访。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a current running a ring of wire back to its source.
core.cn: 核心意象：电流沿一圈导线跑回它的源头。

branches.en: The electric loop is the modern everyday sense.
branches.cn: 电流环路是现代最日常的义项。

branches.en: Any route that returns is a circuit of road.
branches.cn: 任何回到原处的路线都是一圈道路。

branches.en: A judge's round of towns repeats the ring on a map.
branches.cn: 法官巡行各镇，在地图上重复同一个环。

branches.en: Wire and road share one closed geometry.
branches.cn: 导线与道路共享同一个闭合几何。

branches.en: A racing loop and a lecture loop both end where they began.
branches.cn: 赛车环道与巡回讲学都在起点结束。

intro.en: The stem circuit builds a plural, two derived adjectives and a compound verb.
intro.cn: 词干 circuit 构成复数、两个派生形容词以及一个复合动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circum around plus ire to go produced circuitus, the base of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circum（周围）加 ire（走）构成 circuitus，是整个词族的词基。

items.exampleCN: 这块板上集成了三条电路。
我们走了一条绕远的路。
circum- 是 circuit 的开头。

latinEntries.example: Circuitus is the direct source of circuit.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circuitus 是 circuit 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Circumire combines around with to go.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circumire 把周围与走合在一起。

definition_en: shaped like a circle, moving in a circle, or a printed notice sent to many people
core_image: 一张印满字的纸被一份份传下去
scene: 办公室里每人手里都多了一张纸，内容一模一样。The manager sent a circular to every department.
sceneCN: 这里 circular 指「通告」（第 3 个义项：印好并分发给多人的信函）；句意是经理给每个部门都发了一份通告。

senses.title: Shaped like a circle
senses.definition: having the shape of a circle
senses.definitionCN: 具有圆形的形状
senses.example: They sat at a circular table.
senses.exampleCN: 他们围坐在一张圆桌旁。
senses.why: Latin circularis described anything shaped like a small ring.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circularis 描述任何像小圆环一样的东西。

senses.title: Moving around a circle
senses.definition: moving in a circle and returning to the starting point
senses.definitionCN: 沿圆周移动并回到起点
senses.example: The fan makes a slow circular motion.
senses.exampleCN: 风扇缓缓作圆周运动。
senses.why: A shape word also describes the motion that follows that shape.
senses.whyCN: 表示形状的词也用来描述沿这个形状进行的运动。

senses.title: A printed notice sent round
senses.definition: a printed letter or notice sent to many people
senses.definitionCN: 印好并寄发给许多人的信函或通知
senses.example: The manager sent a circular to every department.
senses.exampleCN: 经理给每个部门都发了一份通告。
senses.why: A letter sent round to many readers repeats the idea of going around.
senses.whyCN: 发给许多读者的信，重复的正是「绕一圈送达」的意思。

intro.en: Circular is the Latin adjective built on the word for a small ring.
intro.cn: circular 是拉丁语形容词，建立在小圆环这个词上。

items.en: Circulus meant a small ring.
items.cn: circulus 意为小圆环。

items.en: Circularis meant shaped like a ring.
items.cn: circularis 意为形状像圆环的。

items.en: English circular first described round shapes.
items.cn: 英语 circular 最初描述圆形。

items.en: The noun named a letter sent round to many readers.
items.cn: 名词义指发给许多读者的通函。

items.en: The adjective keeps the shape and the looping motion.
items.cn: 形容词保留了形状义与绕圈的运动义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ring root, while the meaning group names round forms and notices.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语圆环词根，近义组列出圆形与通知。

entries.definition: a round closed shape
a closed path for electric current
a show performed in a ring
entries.definitionCN: 在圆环场地演出的表演

entries.definition: shaped like a circle or a ball
shaped like a ball
a printed announcement for many readers
entries.definitionCN: 供许多人阅读的印刷通知

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the -ar ending, the looping motion and the notice sense.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 -ar 词尾、绕圈运动以及通告义。

normal.en: Circular is simply circle plus an adjective ending, so it means circle-like.
normal.cn: circular 就是 circle 加形容词词尾，意为「像圆的」。

normal.en: A circular table has no head, which is why meetings like it.
normal.cn: 圆桌没有主位，所以开会时人们喜欢用它。

normal.en: A circular argument returns to where it started, like a ring of words.
normal.cn: 循环论证绕回起点，就像一圈词语。

normal.en: A circular letter is sent round to many readers, so the noun keeps the motion.
normal.cn: 通函被绕着发给许多读者，所以名词义保留了运动感。

normal.en: Circularity is the state, and circulate is the verb of the same family.
normal.cn: circularity 是状态，circulate 是同族的动词。

abstract.en: Picture a round table with every chair facing the same centre.
abstract.cn: 想象一张圆桌，每把椅子都朝向同一个中心。

abstract.en: Picture a fan blade tracing the same arc again and again.
abstract.cn: 想象扇叶一遍遍划过同一段弧线。

abstract.en: Picture the same printed sheet passing from desk to desk.
abstract.cn: 想象同一张印刷纸从一张桌子传到另一张桌子。

examples.en: The hall has a circular roof of glass.
examples.cn: 大厅有一个圆形的玻璃顶。

examples.en: The dancers moved in a slow circular pattern.
examples.cn: 舞者按缓慢的圆形队形移动。

examples.en: A circular was pinned to the notice board.
examples.cn: 公告板上钉着一份通告。

dict_mnemonic.text: circular 就是 circle 加 -ar：像圆一样。

root: 源自拉丁语 circularis（圆的），由 circulus（小圆环）加形容词后缀构成，兼指圆形的与传阅的通函。

sensesIntro.en: The ring shape gives the adjective, the ring motion follows it, and a letter sent round gives the noun.
sensesIntro.cn: 圆环形状先给出形容词，绕圈运动随之而来，绕着发送的信又给出名词义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one printed sheet passed from hand to hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张印刷纸从一只手传到另一只手。

branches.en: The shape sense is the oldest adjective use.
branches.cn: 形状义是最早的形容词用法。

branches.en: The motion sense follows the outline of the shape.
branches.cn: 运动义沿着形状的轮廓展开。

branches.en: The noun names the paper that travels round.
branches.cn: 名词指绕行传阅的那张纸。

branches.en: Shape and motion are two views of one ring.
branches.cn: 形状与运动是同一个圆环的两种看法。

branches.en: Both senses keep something going around.
branches.cn: 两个义项都保留了「绕行」的意思。

intro.en: The stem circular builds a plural, two derived forms and a related verb family.
intro.cn: 词干 circular 构成复数、两个派生形式以及一组相关动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circularis grows from circulus, the small ring behind circle.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circularis 由 circulus 长出，后者正是 circle 背后的小圆环。

items.example: The office mailed two hundred circulars.
items.exampleCN: 办公室寄出了两百份通告。

items.example: The circularity of the design is striking.
items.exampleCN: 这个设计的圆润感很醒目。

items.example: The path runs circularly around the lake.
items.exampleCN: 小路绕着湖成环形延伸。

items.example: The circulation of air is poor here.

latinEntries.example: Circularis is the direct source of circular.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circularis 是 circular 的直接来源。

definition_en: to move continuously around a closed system, to pass from person to person, or to send something to many people
core_image: 红色的血在管道里一圈圈地流动
scene: 屋里暖气开得足，空气闷得发沉。Open the window so the air can circulate.
sceneCN: 这里 circulate 指「循环」（第 1 个义项：流体沿闭合系统不断流动）；句意是打开窗户，让空气流通。

senses.title: To move in a loop
senses.definition: to move continuously around a closed system
senses.definitionCN: 沿闭合系统不断流动
senses.example: Blood circulates through the body.
senses.exampleCN: 血液在全身循环。
senses.why: Latin circulare meant to make a ring, and the ring became a path of flow.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circulare 意为使成环，圆环随后成了流动的路径。

senses.title: To pass from person to person
senses.definition: to pass from one person or place to another
senses.definitionCN: 从一人或一处传到另一人另一处
senses.example: The rumour circulated quickly through the office.
senses.exampleCN: 谣言很快在办公室里传开。
senses.why: Goods and news move in a loop through many hands, like liquid in a pipe.
senses.whyCN: 货物与消息像管中液体一样，经许多手绕行流动。

senses.title: To send round to readers
senses.definition: to send something to a number of people in turn
senses.definitionCN: 把某物依次发给若干人
senses.example: The department circulated the draft to all staff.
senses.exampleCN: 部门把草稿传阅给全体员工。
senses.why: Sending a paper round repeats the same circular motion in paper form.
senses.whyCN: 把文件绕着发送，正是以纸张形式重复同一种环形运动。

intro.en: Circulate comes from a Latin verb meaning to make a ring.
intro.cn: circulate 源自一个意为使成环的拉丁语动词。

items.en: Circulus named a small ring.
items.cn: circulus 指小圆环。

items.en: Circulare meant to form something into a ring.
items.cn: circulare 意为使某物形成环。

items.en: Circulatus described something that had gone round.
items.cn: circulatus 描述已经绕行过的东西。

items.en: English circulate first described the movement of fluids.
items.cn: 英语 circulate 最初描述流体的运动。

items.en: The verb widened to news, money and papers sent round.
items.cn: 这个动词扩展到消息、货币与绕着发送的文件。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ring root, while the meaning group names kinds of movement.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语圆环词根，近义组列出各种流动与散布。

entries.definition: a round closed shape
shaped like a circle
a closed path for electric current
to move steadily like a liquid
to reach more people or places
entries.definitionCN: 传到更多人或更多地方

entries.definition: to give out something to many people

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the ring stem, the blood image and the three objects that travel.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用圆环词干、血液意象以及三种会流传的东西。

normal.en: Split circulate into circ and late: a circle moving slowly round.
normal.cn: 把 circulate 拆成 circ 与 late：一个圈慢慢地转动。

normal.en: Blood circulates, money circulates, news circulates: three things in one loop.
normal.cn: blood circulates、money circulates、news circulates，三样东西走同一个环。

normal.en: The ending -ate marks the verb, while circulation is the matching noun.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ate 标记动词，circulation 是对应的名词。

normal.en: Circulate a letter means to send it round, so the paper itself travels.
normal.cn: circulate a letter 意为把信绕着传，纸本身也在旅行。

normal.en: Free circulation of goods is the economic face of the same ring.
normal.cn: 货物自由流通是同一个圆环的经济面孔。

abstract.en: Picture red blood turning a corner inside a warm vessel.
abstract.cn: 想象红色的血在温暖的血管里拐过一个弯。

abstract.en: Picture a whispered sentence passing along a row of desks.
abstract.cn: 想象一句低声的话沿着一排桌子传过去。

abstract.en: Picture one folder moving from hand to hand in a meeting.
abstract.cn: 想象开会时一个文件夹从一只手传到另一只手。

examples.en: Exercise helps the blood circulate faster.
examples.cn: 运动有助于血液加快循环。

examples.en: The story circulated through the whole school.
examples.cn: 这个故事传遍了整所学校。

examples.en: Please circulate the agenda before the meeting.
examples.cn: 请在会前把议程传阅一下。

dict_mnemonic.text: circulate 里的 circ 是圈，late 有「慢慢」的意思：绕着圈慢慢流动。

root: 源自拉丁语 circulare（使成环、绕行），由 circulus（小圆环）派生，本指沿环流动。

sensesIntro.en: Making a ring produces the idea of flow, which spreads from blood to money and news, and then to papers sent round.
sensesIntro.cn: 「使成环」先产生流动的意思，再从血液扩展到货币与消息，最后指绕着发送的文件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: red blood turning a corner inside a pipe.
core.cn: 核心意象：红色的血在管道里拐过一个弯。

branches.en: The bodily flow is the first recorded sense.
branches.cn: 体内的流动是最早有记录的义项。

branches.en: Money and news repeat the same loop among people.
branches.cn: 货币与消息在人群中重复同一个环。

branches.en: Sending a paper round is the loop made of paper.
branches.cn: 把文件绕着发送，是用纸做成的环。

branches.en: Body and market share one verb of continuous flow.
branches.cn: 身体与市场共用一个表示持续流动的动词。

branches.en: A rumour circulates just as a letter is circulated.
branches.cn: 谣言会流传，信件也会被传阅。

intro.en: The verb stem builds a noun, an adjective and the whole circle family.
intro.cn: 这个动词词干构成名词、形容词以及整个 circle 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin circulare and circulatus supply the -ate ending of the English verb.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circulare 与 circulatus 提供了这个英语动词的 -ate 词尾。

items.exampleCN: 那份通知上周传阅过了。

items.example: The library keeps the book circulating.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆让这本书持续流通。

items.example: Good circulation keeps the room fresh.
items.exampleCN: 良好的流通让房间保持清新。

items.example: The heart is a circulatory organ.
items.exampleCN: 心脏是循环系统的器官。

latinEntries.example: Circulare is the direct source of circulate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circulare 是 circulate 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Circulatus supplied the past forms.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circulatus 提供了过去式形式。

definition_en: the movement of blood around the body, the passing of money or news among people, or the number of copies of a publication sold
core_image: 报纸从印刷机上一叠叠装车送走
scene: 报摊上的报纸一早就被取空，印刷机还在转。The magazine has a circulation of half a million.
sceneCN: 这里 circulation 指「发行量」（第 3 个义项：报刊每期售出的份数）；句意是这本杂志的发行量有五十万份。

senses.title: Movement of blood
senses.definition: the movement of blood around the body
senses.definitionCN: 血液在全身的流动
senses.example: Exercise improves the circulation.
senses.exampleCN: 运动能改善血液循环。
senses.why: Latin circulatio named the act of moving in a ring, and blood was the first thing described.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circulatio 指沿环移动，血液是最早被描述的对象。

senses.title: Passing among people
senses.definition: the passing of money, goods or news among people
senses.definitionCN: 货币、货物或消息在人群中的流转
senses.example: New coins are now in circulation.
senses.exampleCN: 新硬币现在已在流通。
senses.why: Money and news follow the same loop as blood in a body.
senses.whyCN: 货币与消息遵循的正是血液在体内那样的环路。

senses.title: Copies sold or sent out
senses.definition: the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine sold
senses.definitionCN: 报刊每期售出的份数
senses.example: The magazine has a circulation of half a million.
senses.exampleCN: 这本杂志的发行量有五十万份。
senses.why: The number of copies sent round measures how far the paper travels.
senses.whyCN: 绕着送出的份数，衡量的就是这份报纸走得有多远。

intro.en: Circulation is the Latin noun of action for moving in a ring.
intro.cn: circulation 是表示沿环移动的拉丁语动作名词。

items.en: Circulus named a small ring.
items.cn: circulus 指小圆环。

items.en: Circulare meant to move something round.
items.cn: circulare 意为使某物绕行。

items.en: Circulatio named the act of going round.
items.cn: circulatio 指绕行的动作。

items.en: English circulation first described the blood.
items.cn: 英语 circulation 最初描述血液的流动。

items.en: The word extended to money, news and printed copies.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到货币、消息与印刷份数。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin ring root, while the meaning group names flows and reach.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语圆环词根，近义组列出流动与覆盖范围。

entries.definition: a round closed shape
shaped like a circle
a closed path for electric current
a steady movement of liquid or air
entries.definitionCN: 液体或空气平稳的流动

entries.definition: the act of giving out to many people
the people who read a publication
entries.definitionCN: 阅读某份出版物的人群

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the -ion noun ending, the blood image and the newspaper number.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 -ion 名词词尾、血液意象以及报刊份数。

normal.en: Circulation is the noun of circulate, so the ending -ion marks the act.
normal.cn: circulation 是 circulate 的名词，-ion 词尾标记动作。

normal.en: Blood circulation, money circulation, newspaper circulation: three loops of different size.
normal.cn: blood circulation、money circulation、newspaper circulation，三个大小不同的环。

normal.en: In circulation means out among people, not locked in a drawer.
normal.cn: in circulation 指在人群里流转，而不是锁在抽屉里。

normal.en: A magazine with a large circulation reaches many hands each month.
normal.cn: 发行量大的杂志每个月能到许多人手里。

normal.en: Withdraw from circulation is the opposite path, taking money or goods out of the loop.
normal.cn: withdraw from circulation 是相反的路径，把钱或货从环里取出。

abstract.en: Picture a warm pulse moving from the wrist up the arm.
abstract.cn: 想象温热的脉搏从手腕一路向上走。

abstract.en: Picture a coin passing through five hands in one day.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚硬币一天里经过五个人的手。

abstract.en: Picture stacked papers sliding into a delivery van.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠叠报纸滑进送货车里。

examples.en: Cold hands are a sign of poor circulation.
examples.cn: 手发凉是循环不好的迹象。

examples.en: The old notes were taken out of circulation.
examples.cn: 旧纸币被停止流通。

examples.en: The paper doubled its circulation in one year.
examples.cn: 这家报纸一年内发行量翻了一倍。

dict_mnemonic.text: circulation 与 circulate 同根：绕一圈送出的份数，就是发行量。

root: 源自拉丁语 circulatio（绕行），由 circulare（使成环）派生，本指沿环流动，后指报刊绕送的份数。

sensesIntro.en: The act of moving in a ring starts with blood, then covers money and news, and finally counts the copies sent out.
sensesIntro.cn: 沿环移动先落在血液上，再覆盖货币与消息，最后用来数绕着送出的份数。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: printed sheets leaving the press in tight stacks.
core.cn: 核心意象：印好的纸一叠叠离开印刷机。

branches.en: Blood is the first and most physical sense.
branches.cn: 血液是最早也最具体的义项。

branches.en: Money and news repeat the bodily loop in society.
branches.cn: 货币与消息在社会中重复身体里的环。

branches.en: The count of copies measures the width of the loop.
branches.cn: 份数衡量的是这个环有多宽。

branches.en: Body and economy share one noun of continuous flow.
branches.cn: 身体与经济共用一个表示持续流动的名词。

branches.en: A paper in circulation earns its circulation figure.
branches.cn: 在流通中的报纸才挣得它的发行量数字。

intro.en: The noun stem builds a plural, an adjective and the verb it comes from.
intro.cn: 这个名词词干构成复数、一个形容词以及它由之而来的动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circulatio grows from circulare, and -ion marks the resulting action noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circulatio 由 circulare 长出，-ion 标记由此形成的动作名词。

items.example: The two papers report different circulations.
items.exampleCN: 两家报纸公布的发行量不同。

items.example: Air must circulate behind the fridge.
The tank has a circular base.
items.exampleCN: 这个罐子有一个圆形底座。

items.example: The circle is drawn in chalk.

latinEntries.example: Circulatio is the direct source of circulation.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circulatio 是 circulation 的直接来源。

definition_en: the facts and conditions that affect an event, the conditions of a person's life, or a person's financial position
core_image: 一个人站在四周密密麻麻的条件中间
scene: 雨下得很大，末班车又提前开走了。Under the circumstances, we decided to stay.
sceneCN: 这里 circumstances 指「情况」（第 1 个义项：影响某个决定的周边事实）；句意是在这种情况下，我们决定留下。

senses.title: The facts around an event
senses.definition: the facts and conditions that affect an event or a decision
senses.definitionCN: 影响某个事件或决定的周边事实与条件
senses.example: Under the circumstances, we decided to stay.
senses.exampleCN: 在这种情况下，我们决定留下。
senses.why: Latin circumstantia meant standing around, so the facts standing around an event took the name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 circumstantia 意为站在四周，围绕事件的事实便得了这个名字。

senses.title: Surrounding conditions
senses.definition: the conditions of life that surround a person or a group
senses.definitionCN: 围绕一个人或一群人的生活条件
senses.example: Children here grow up in difficult circumstances.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的孩子在艰难的环境中长大。
senses.why: What stands around a person forms the setting of a whole life.
senses.whyCN: 围绕一个人站立的东西，构成了整段生活的背景。

senses.title: Financial position
senses.definition: the level of money and comfort of a person or a family
senses.definitionCN: 个人或家庭的金钱与生活水平
senses.example: Her circumstances improved after the new job.
senses.exampleCN: 新工作之后她的境况好转了。
senses.why: Money became the measure of the ground a person stands on.
senses.whyCN: 金钱成了衡量一个人脚下立足之地的尺度。

intro.en: Circumstance is Latin for a standing around, as conditions stand around an event.
intro.cn: circumstance 在拉丁语中意为「站在四周」，正如条件围绕事件而立。

items.en: Circum meant around on every side.
items.cn: circum 意为四周环绕。

items.en: Stare meant to stand.
items.cn: stare 意为站立。

items.en: Circumstantia named the things standing around.
items.cn: circumstantia 指站在四周的事物。

items.en: Circonstance carried the word into French.
items.cn: circonstance 把这个词带进法语。

items.en: English circumstance named the setting of an act.
items.cn: 英语 circumstance 指一个行为的背景。

items.en: The plural widened to life conditions and money.
items.cn: 复数形式扩展到生活条件与金钱状况。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the circum- opening, while the meaning group names settings and conditions.
note.cn: 形近组共享 circum- 开头，近义组列出背景与条件。

entries.definition: the distance around the edge of a circle
based on indirect evidence
to find a way around a rule
the set of things happening at a time
entries.definitionCN: 某一时刻发生的一整套事情

entries.definition: the state that something is in
the facts around an event or a word
entries.definitionCN: 围绕事件或词语的事实

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the standing-around image, the three senses and the fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用「站在四周」的意象、三层意思以及固定搭配。

normal.en: Split circumstance into circum and stance: everything standing around you.
normal.cn: 把 circumstance 拆成 circum 与 stance：站在你四周的一切。

normal.en: Under the circumstances is the most common frame, meaning because of the facts.
normal.cn: under the circumstances 是最常见的框架，意为「鉴于这些事实」。

normal.en: Under no circumstances is a strong refusal, and it keeps the same plural shape.
normal.cn: under no circumstances 表示坚决否定，形状仍是复数。

normal.en: The plural is normal, because many conditions stand around one event.
normal.cn: 通常用复数，因为围绕一个事件的条件有很多。

normal.en: Circumstantial evidence is evidence from the things standing around a case.
normal.cn: circumstantial evidence 就是来自案件周边事物的证据。

abstract.en: Picture a person standing still while rain, traffic and clock hands press in.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人站住不动，雨、车流与钟表的指针都压过来。

abstract.en: Picture a small family in a narrow room with one lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小家庭挤在有盏灯的窄房间里。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of bills on a kitchen table.
abstract.cn: 想象厨房桌上放着一叠账单。

examples.en: Under the circumstances, the delay was understandable.
examples.cn: 在这种情况下，延误是可以理解的。

examples.en: Many families live in hard circumstances.
examples.cn: 许多家庭生活在艰苦的环境中。

examples.en: He rose above his circumstances through study.
examples.cn: 他靠学习摆脱了自己的境况。

dict_mnemonic.text: circumstance 拆成 circum 与 stance：站在你周围的一切，就是你的处境。

root: 源自拉丁语 circumstantia（站在四周），由 circum（周围）与 stare（站立）构成，本指围绕事件的条件。

sensesIntro.en: Things standing around an act give the case facts, then the setting of a life, and finally the money a person stands on.
sensesIntro.cn: 围绕行为而立的事物先给出具体情况，再给出生活背景，最后给出一个人脚下的钱财。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure standing in the middle of pressing conditions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在层层条件包围的中间。

branches.en: The facts of a case are the first sense.
branches.cn: 案件的具体事实是第一层意思。

branches.en: The setting of a life is the plural at work.
branches.cn: 生活背景是复数形式的常见用法。

branches.en: Money is the narrowest and most personal sense.
branches.cn: 金钱是最窄也最贴近个人的义项。

branches.en: One event and a whole life both sit inside conditions.
branches.cn: 单个事件与整段人生都坐在条件之中。

branches.en: Money decides much of the ground a family stands on.
branches.cn: 金钱决定了一个家庭脚下的大部分立足之地。

intro.en: The stem builds a plural, an adjective and an adverb from one Latin frame.
intro.cn: 这个词干在一个拉丁框架上构成复数、形容词与副词。

latinIntro.en: Latin circum around plus stare to stand produced circumstantia, the base of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circum（周围）加 stare（站立）构成 circumstantia，是整个词族的词基。

items.exampleCN: 当时的情况对我们不利。

items.example: The case rested on circumstantial proof.

items.exampleCN: 这一关联是以间接方式证明的。
circum- 是 circumstance 的开头。

items.example: Stance carries the sense of standing.

latinEntries.example: Circumstantia is the direct source of circumstance.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circumstantia 是 circumstance 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Circumstare joins around with to stand.
latinEntries.exampleCN: circumstare 把周围与站立合在一起。

definition_en: to quote a source, to give something as an example or proof, or to order someone to appear in court
core_image: 论文脚注里列出的一个个人名与书名
scene: 论文写到最后，作者逐条核对来源。She cited three studies in the first paragraph.
sceneCN: 这里 cited 是 cite 的过去式，指「引用」（第 1 个义项：提到他人的话或文字作为依据）；句意是她在第一段引用了三项研究。

senses.title: To quote a source
senses.definition: to mention words or writing from another source as support
senses.definitionCN: 提到他人的话语或文字作为依据
senses.example: She cited three studies in the first paragraph.
senses.exampleCN: 她在第一段引用了三项研究。
senses.why: Latin citare meant to call, and calling a writer into your text became quoting.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 citare 意为召唤，把作者召进自己的文章便成了引用。

senses.title: To give as proof
senses.definition: to mention something as an example or as proof
senses.definitionCN: 举出某事物作为例子或证据
senses.example: He cited the falling sales as a warning.
senses.exampleCN: 他举出销量下滑作为警告。
senses.why: A summoned witness and a summoned fact both serve as proof.
senses.whyCN: 被召来的证人与被召来的事实，都是用来作证的。

senses.title: To summon to court
senses.definition: to order someone to appear in a court of law
senses.definitionCN: 命令某人出庭
senses.example: The driver was cited for speeding.
senses.exampleCN: 那名司机因超速被传唤。
senses.why: The oldest sense is legal: to call a person before a judge.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的一层意思属法律：把人叫到法官面前。

intro.en: Cite began as a Latin verb for summoning a person.
intro.cn: cite 最初是一个表示传唤人的拉丁语动词。

items.en: Ciere meant to set something in motion.
items.cn: ciere 意为使某物动起来。

items.en: Citare meant to call or to summon someone.
items.cn: citare 意为呼唤或传唤某人。

items.en: Citer narrowed to calling a person to court.
items.cn: citer 的词义收窄为传人出庭。

items.en: English cite kept the legal summons and added quoting.
items.cn: 英语 cite 保留法律传唤，又添上引用的意思。

items.en: Scholarship made citing sources an everyday act.
items.cn: 学术写作让引用出处成了日常动作。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the sound of cite, while the meaning group names quoting and summoning.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cite 的读音，近义组列出引用与传唤。

entries.definition: a place where something is built
the ability to see
a tool with a long blade for cutting grass
to repeat the words of a source
to mention a source in a text
to order someone to appear

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the three same-sound words, the court origin and the academic habit.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用三个同音词、法庭来源以及学术习惯。

normal.en: Cite, site and sight sound alike, so check which one you wrote.
normal.cn: cite、site 与 sight 读音相同，写完要检查用的是哪一个。

normal.en: The oldest cite is a court summons, which is why a speeding driver is cited.
normal.cn: 最古老的 cite 是法庭传唤，所以超速司机会被 cite。

normal.en: To cite a study is to call the researchers into your own paragraph.
normal.cn: cite a study 就是把研究者召进你自己的段落。

normal.en: Citation is the noun, covering a footnote, a prize and a summons.
normal.cn: citation 是名词，涵盖脚注、表彰与传唤。

normal.en: Citing reasons is citing proof, not quoting words.
normal.cn: cite reasons 是举出证据，不是引用原话。

abstract.en: Picture a name in small print at the bottom of a page.
abstract.cn: 想象页面底部一行小字里的一个人名。

abstract.en: Picture a hand raising a folder to show one page in court.
abstract.cn: 想象法庭上一只手举起文件夹，翻出其中一页。

abstract.en: Picture a ribbon pinned on a coat for bravery.
abstract.cn: 想象外套上为表彰勇敢而别上的绶带。

examples.en: Please cite the original article, not the summary.
examples.cn: 请引用原始文章，而不是摘要。

examples.en: The report cites rising costs as the main cause.
examples.cn: 报告举出成本上升作为主要原因。

examples.en: Two officers were cited for their courage.
examples.cn: 两名警官因勇敢受到表彰。

dict_mnemonic.text: cite 与 site、sight 同音：写论文时要看清是引用、地点还是看见。

root: 源自拉丁语 citare（召唤），是 ciere（使动）的反复形式，本指传唤出庭，后转指引用。

sensesIntro.en: A court summons gives the idea of calling something in, which supplies both the quoted source and the proof.
sensesIntro.cn: 法庭传唤先给出「召来」的意思，由此生出被引的原文与被举的证据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name listed in small print under a page.
core.cn: 核心意象：页面下方用小字列出的一个名字。

branches.en: Quoting is the everyday sense in study and writing.
branches.cn: 引用是学习与写作中最日常的义项。

branches.en: Citing proof calls a fact into the argument.
branches.cn: 举出证据就是把一项事实召进论证。

branches.en: The court summons is the oldest sense still in use.
branches.cn: 法庭传唤是仍在使用的最古老义项。

branches.en: A quoted source and a cited fact both support a claim.
branches.cn: 被引的原文与被举的事实都支撑一个主张。

branches.en: Citation can mean praise as well as a summons.
branches.cn: citation 既可指传唤，也可指表彰。

intro.en: The short stem builds a noun, two adjectives and the whole citation family.
intro.cn: 这个短词干构成名词、两个形容词以及整个 citation 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin citare and its base ciere supply the -ate pattern behind cite.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 citare 及其词基 ciere 提供了 cite 背后的 -ate 构词模式。

items.example: Cite the page number as well.
The judge cited the earlier ruling.
items.exampleCN: 法官援引了先前的裁决。

items.example: He was citing a long report.
items.exampleCN: 他正在引用一份长报告。
这篇论文有五十条引文。

latinEntries.example: Citare is the direct source of cite.
latinEntries.exampleCN: citare 是 cite 的直接来源。

latinEntries.example: Ciere is the older base of citare.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ciere 是 citare 更古老的词基。

definition_en: a person who legally belongs to a country and has rights there, a person who lives in a city, or an ordinary person
core_image: 投票站门口排队的人手里捏着证件
scene: 投票站门口排起长队，人们手里捏着证件。Every citizen has the right to vote.
sceneCN: 这里 citizen 指「公民」（第 1 个义项：在法律上属于某国并享有权利的人）；句意是每个公民都有投票权。

senses.title: A member of a state
senses.definition: a person who legally belongs to a country and has rights there
senses.definitionCN: 在法律上属于某国并享有权利的人
senses.example: Every citizen has the right to vote.
senses.exampleCN: 每个公民都有投票权。
senses.why: Latin civitas named the body of people in a city state, and one member of it became a citizen.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 civitas 指城邦中的全体人民，其中一员便成了公民。

senses.title: A person of a city
senses.definition: a person who lives in a particular city
senses.definitionCN: 居住在某座城市的人
senses.example: The citizens of the town built the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城的市民修建了那座桥。
senses.why: The word began with the city, and the town sense is the older local one.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本与城市相连，城镇义是更早的地方性含义。

senses.title: An ordinary person
senses.definition: an ordinary person rather than an official or a soldier
senses.definitionCN: 相对于官员或军人而言的普通人
senses.example: The mayor met a few private citizens.

examples.cn: 十年之后他回归了平民生活。

examples.en: The radar is now made for civilian use.
examples.cn: 这种雷达现在为民用而制造。

dict_mnemonic.text: civilian 就是 civil 加 -ian：过民事生活的人，就是平民。

root: 源自古法语 civilien，由拉丁语 civilis（公民的）派生，本指过民事生活而非军旅生活的人。

sensesIntro.en: A person of civil law becomes a person outside the army, and the contrast then extends to ordinary equipment.
sensesIntro.cn: 研习民法的人先变成军队之外的人，这种对比再扩展到普通器物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a plain coat standing outside a row of uniforms.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件素色外套站在一排队列军装之外。

branches.en: The person outside the army is the central sense.
branches.cn: 军队之外的人是核心义项。

branches.en: The adjective carries the same line into objects.
branches.cn: 形容词把同一条界线带到物品上。

branches.en: A civilian person and civilian equipment share one contrast.
branches.cn: 平民与民用装备共享同一种对比。

branches.en: Civilians are defined by what they are not.
branches.cn: 平民是靠「不是什么」来定义的。

branches.en: Civilian use marks the peaceful side of a technology.
branches.cn: 民用标记出一项技术的和平一面。

intro.en: The stem builds a plural, a verb, an abstract noun and a slang clipping.
intro.cn: 这个词干构成复数、动词、抽象名词以及一个口语缩略词。

latinIntro.en: Old French civilien and Latin civilis supply both the base and the -ian ending.
latinIntro.cn: 古法语 civilien 与拉丁语 civilis 提供了词基与 -ian 词尾。

items.exampleCN: 一位平民拦下了那辆车。

items.meaningCN: 使转为平民或民用性质
items.example: The base was civilianized after the war.
items.exampleCN: 战后这座基地转为民用。

items.meaningCN: 平民化或民用化的过程
items.exampleCN: 民用化改变了整个地区。

items.example: He changed into civvy after work.

items.exampleCN: 基地之外适用民事规则。

latinEntries.example: Civilien is the direct source of civilian.
latinEntries.exampleCN: civilien 是 civilian 的直接来源。
